temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual during their bank shifts; she says it is nothing really, just personal stuff, and appreciates Jose's offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is normally vibrant and there is no known reason for concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his suspicion that something is troubling Patricia is strengthened, though she does not disclose details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is dealing with unspecified personal issues and may be feeling down; she values having someone to listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer non-intrusive support and be available if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During lunch, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and says she will take him up on his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has private personal troubles and has seemed withdrawn, but Jose does not know the specific cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he learns that financial stress is a likely source of her distress and that she is open to discussing budgeting/financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is overwhelmed by bills and financial commitments, and she may welcome practical help with budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer a low-pressure opportunity to discuss budgeting/financial planning when she is ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that he was not prying by bringing up financial planning and says she is grateful for his offer to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia accepted his offer of financial/budgeting help, but Jose worries he may have overstepped her boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his worry about overstepping is alleviated by Patricia's reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia does not think he overstepped; she appreciates his support and feels she can turn to him, while Jose should remain respectful of her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry/anxiety turning to relief and gratitude.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend while respecting her privacy and avoiding pressure.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is all good, plans a quiet weekend at home, thanks Jose, and says she will keep his offer in mind; Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and may turn to him, and Jose remains concerned about her personal/financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he interprets her response as a preference for privacy and independent handling rather than immediate sharing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his concern but is handling her issues privately; Jose should stay available without pressing for details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Remain available and check in casually/supportively, but give her space and do not intrude.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in supportively; Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates support but prefers privacy and is handling her issues herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; the event reinforces that she is managing and values his supportive presence without wanting deeper involvement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but managing her issues, and she appreciates low-pressure support; Jose can continue being a supportive colleague/friend without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue offering low-pressure help and regular check-ins, such as coffee, while respecting her boundaries.
